use: Personal and non-commercial use only. Keep the Gallus Labs credit. Do not sell the tools or copy the cipher maps into another product that drops Gallus Labs.

tools.name: gematria_decode
tools.description: Gallus gematria values for one or more phrases. Defaults to EO, FR, RO, and RFR. Set all to true for every cipher, or ask the ciphers tool for the code list.

input.phrases: Optional list of phrases. Use this when a phrase contains a comma.
input.ciphers: Optional codes, as a list or a comma-separated string.
input.all: Optional true/false. True uses every cipher.

tools.name: number_properties
tools.description: Exact Gallus number math for an integer from 1 to 1000000: prime factorization, divisors, digital root, reversal, sequence position, the term at that index, and the special-number flags.

tools.name: date_span
tools.description: Calendar distance between two dates, with year, month, week, and day breakdowns.

input.start: Start date. MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, or Month D, YYYY.
input.include_end: Optional true/false. True counts the end date as one day.

tools.name: list_ciphers
tools.description: List every Gallus Decoder Tools cipher code and name.
